set.st: Robbers who murdered Col. George Davenport in his island house on 4 July 1845 were after money he was believed to keep there. A period-based 1891 account says they got only a gold watch and a small sum: he had sent $10,000 to St. Louis a week earlier, and nothing in the record says any money was hidden on the island. The story of a cache here comes from later forum retellings. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.tovw: Lead grade F: the 1891 account shows the robbers got almost nothing and the money had been sent away; no period source says anything was hidden on the island, which is federal look-only land in any case
